title: Disentangled Sparse Representations for Concept-Separated Diffusion Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2605.12122v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unlearning specific concepts in text-to-image diffusion models has become increasingly important for preventing undesirable content generation. Among prior approaches, sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based methods have attracted attention due to their ability to suppress target concepts through lightweight manipulation of latent features, without modifying model parameters. However, SAEs trained primarily for sparse reconstruction do not explicitly enforce concept-wise separation, allowing semantically related concepts to share latent features. To address this, we propose SAEParate, which explicitly separates semantically overlapping concepts in the SAE latent space through concept-aware contrastive learning, supported by cross-attention-guided spatial aggregation that emphasizes concept-relevant regions. In addition, we enhance the encoder with a nonlinear transformation to increase its expressive capacity under this separation objective,

translated_title: 面向概念分离扩散模型遗忘的解耦稀疏表示
translated_abstract: 在文本到图像扩散模型中遗忘特定概念对于防止生成不良内容正变得日益重要。在先前的方法中，基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的方法因能够通过轻量级地操纵潜在特征来抑制目标概念、且无需修改模型参数而备受关注。然而，主要以稀疏重建为目标训练的SAE并未显式地强制实现概念间的分离，使得语义相关的概念可能共享潜在特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SAEParate，通过概念感知的对比学习在SAE潜在空间中显式分离语义重叠的概念，并由交叉注意力引导的空间聚合加以支持，该聚合机制强调与概念相关的区域。此外，我们通过非线性变换增强编码器，以提升其在该分离目标下的表达能力。
tldr: 提出SAEParate方法，通过概念感知对比学习与交叉注意力引导的空间聚合，在稀疏自编码器潜在空间中显式解耦语义重叠的概念，从而在不修改模型参数的情况下实现扩散模型的精确概念遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAEParate, which explicitly disentangles semantically overlapping concepts in the SAE latent space through concept-aware contrastive learning with cross-attention-guided spatial aggregation, enabling lightweight concept unlearning in diffusion models without modifying model parameters.
